services.pageSubtitle: End-to-end services for restaurant owners and investors in Saudi Arabia — from setup to development, valuation and brokerage

restaurant-setup.title: Restaurant Setup
restaurant-setup.short: From idea to opening day: market study, site selection, and full operational setup.
body: Opening a restaurant is a major decision that starts well before signing a lease. Bait Al Mataem helps you study the concept, market and competitors, and choose the right activity, location and size before spending a single riyal.
We also cover setup cost estimates, equipment, staffing needs, and a full pre-opening and opening plan — so you start on solid ground, not just enthusiasm.

restaurant-operations.title: Restaurant Operations & Management
restaurant-operations.short: Clear operating systems instead of relying on specific individuals.
body: Good operations is a system, not a dependency on one manager or chef. We help build the org structure, job descriptions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for every stage: receiving, storage, prep, production, service, cleanliness and food safety.
We also cover inventory, waste, purchasing, suppliers and performance evaluation, with recurring reports so you can track your business without being there every minute.

restaurant-development.title: Restaurant Development
restaurant-development.short: Weak sales? We find the real cause before proposing any fix.
body: When a restaurant underperforms, we don't assume the market is the problem. We analyze location, product, pricing, quality, service, menu, food cost, labor, waste, inventory and customer experience to find the real cause first.
Then we build a measurable development plan across 30, 60 and 90-day phases, with clear KPIs for each stage.

feasibility-study.title: Feasibility Studies
feasibility-study.short: Before you invest your capital, know — with numbers — whether the idea is worth it.
body: A restaurant feasibility study in Saudi Arabia, as we build it, covers at minimum: activity description, market/area/competitor analysis, target audience, initial investment and setup costs, fixed and variable costs, projected sales, food cost and labor cost, break-even point, cash flow, ROI, and scenario analysis (conservative, expected, optimistic).
We don't invent numbers. When data is insufficient, we use reasonable estimates and state clearly that they are assumptions needing verification, always ending with a clear recommendation.

restaurant-valuation.title: Restaurant Valuation Before Purchase
restaurant-valuation.short: Don't buy an opportunity based on the seller's numbers alone.
body: Before buying or taking over an existing restaurant, we help verify actual sales, expenses, staffing, rent, liabilities, license status and equipment condition — instead of relying on the seller's word.
We calculate the real economic value of the opportunity, not just the asking price, and help you reach a clear decision: buy, buy after negotiation, further study, or decline.

restaurant-brokerage.title: Buying, Selling & Taking Over Restaurants
restaurant-brokerage.short: Brokerage that reaches genuinely serious buyers and investors.
body: Whether you want to sell or hand over your restaurant, or you're looking for an existing business to buy, Bait Al Mataem manages the process professionally: qualifying the other party, arranging viewings, managing negotiation, and following the deal through to close.
We protect your project's data from non-serious inquiries, and we never hide material information that affects an investor's decision.

restaurant-consulting.title: Restaurant Consulting
restaurant-consulting.short: A direct professional opinion, even when it's not what you want to hear.
body: Flexible consulting for restaurant owners and investors on any operational or investment decision: from site selection to menu pricing to evaluating an expansion opportunity.
We don't agree with an idea just because it's yours. If a decision is weak or the risk is high, we say so clearly and present alternatives.

cost-profitability.title: Cost & Profitability Analysis
cost-profitability.short: High sales alone don't mean a successful restaurant.
body: We analyze the full relationship between sales, food cost, labor cost, rent, operating expenses, gross and net profit, and cash flow — because rising sales alone isn't proof of success.
The goal is healthy sales, real profitability and sustainable cash flow, not just an attractive sales figure on paper.

waste-management.title: Waste Management
waste-management.short: A large share of lost profit disappears in waste, not in sales.
body: We review the receiving, storage, prep and inventory cycle to identify real sources of waste: poor storage, portion drift from recipes, weak inventory control, or mispricing.
We set clear, measurable operating procedures to reduce waste — not generic advice with no implementation.

menu-development.title: Menu Development
menu-development.short: A menu built on numbers, not personal taste alone.
body: We review each item's sales, profitability and food cost, identify your highest-margin and weakest-selling items, and propose changes that reduce operational complexity while raising margin.
The goal is a menu that's simpler to run and more profitable — not just more varied.

restaurant-marketing.title: Restaurant Marketing
restaurant-marketing.short: Marketing aimed at more orders and profit, not just views.
body: We build a marketing plan tied to a clear business goal: more orders, a higher average check, more repeat visits, and better visibility on Google Maps, delivery apps and social media.
Every marketing activity we propose is tied to a measurable indicator, not just because it's trending.

staff-recruitment.title: Staff Recruitment & Hiring
staff-recruitment.short: We help you choose and hire the right team, from initial candidate screening through interviews.
body: Bait Al Mataem offers a specialized recruitment service for restaurant, hotel, catering, café and buffet owners, helping them select the right team instead of spending significant time and effort searching and screening on their own.

We take in your hiring needs (roles, number of openings, requirements), screen suitable candidates, conduct initial interviews, and shortlist the closest matches so you can make the final decision yourself.
The service is available to restaurant, hotel, café, buffet, catering and food-service business owners. The service fee depends on the number of roles and openings — contact us for details.

about.title: About Us
body: Bait Al Mataem is a specialized platform for restaurant setup, operations, development and investment, bringing together operational knowledge, investment analysis and marketing in one system that helps restaurant owners and investors make clearer, lower-risk decisions.

We work through specialized expertise and an integrated team across the different areas of the restaurant sector — from studying the concept, location and investment feasibility, through setup, operations and cost control, to development, marketing and evaluating sale and purchase opportunities.
We're starting with a focus on Jeddah and Makkah, while building a platform designed from the ground up to expand to the rest of Saudi Arabia.

joinUs.pageSubtitle: Two ways to work with Bait Al Mataem: join us part-time, or become a referral partner who brings us real opportunities for a commission.

partTime.title: Part-time work
body: If you'd like to join the Bait Al Mataem team part-time in marketing, operations or admin tasks, send us your details and experience through the contact form, and we'll get back to you if a suitable opening comes up.

referral.title: Become a referral partner
body: If you have a network in the restaurant sector and know of a real opportunity — a restaurant for sale or takeover, a suitable space for lease, or an investor looking for a deal — you can submit it to us through the "List Your Opportunity" form.
If the deal closes through you, you earn a commission on it.
referral.note: The commission rate and terms are agreed directly between you and Bait Al Mataem before work begins on each opportunity, and vary by the type and size of the opportunity — contact us for full details.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains how Bait Al Mataem handles visitor and prospective-client data. This is an early, condensed version that will be finalized and legally reviewed as the platform grows and is connected to a real database; until then, treat this page as an initial notice rather than a final legal document.
privacyBody: The data we may currently collect is limited to what a visitor submits directly through the contact form or the "List Your Opportunity" form (such as name, phone number, city, and listing details). This data is not yet stored in a permanent database, since the site is at an early MVP stage.
Bait Al Mataem does not share client data with any third party for marketing purposes without explicit consent. Contact details are used solely to respond to an inquiry or review a submitted listing.
Once the site is connected to a real database, this policy will be updated with precise details on data storage, retention, and a user's right to access or delete their data.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of the Bait Al Mataem website. This is an early, condensed version that will be finalized and legally reviewed as the platform grows; until then, treat this page as an initial notice rather than a final legal document.
termsBody: Content shown in the Opportunities Marketplace (restaurants, sites, and investment opportunities) is reviewed by the Bait Al Mataem team before publishing; however, Bait Al Mataem does not guarantee the accuracy of every detail supplied by a listing owner, and advises any investor to conduct independent verification before making a purchase or investment decision.

Prices and financial figures shown in feasibility studies or opportunity valuations are estimates or analytical projections by nature unless explicitly stated otherwise, and do not constitute a guarantee of any future return or outcome.
Using the site to list an opportunity or to contact Bait Al Mataem does not create any contractual obligation unless followed by a separate written agreement between the parties.
